en: Time is running out for me... for us all...
%s dissipates before your eyes.
We barely have any excess supplies.  It'll take a lot more work before we're ready to send another ground assault into the Field of Strife.
You're just in time, $c.  Do you feel the ground shaking beneath you?$B$BSomething approaches from the hive.  Take a place near the grunts, $n.  I'm counting on you!

All of the skyborne islands became destabilized and began to move apart a few years ago. If that wasn't bad enough, now large pieces of Zephras are beginning to fall away. It's hard to imagine your home falling into the sky, but that is my reality now.
You've done it, $n! <The strangely familiar voice seems to be coming from the phial!> Hurry back! The fallout will only remain stable for thirty minutes.
Don't be shy, buy a round for everyone!
They put these lanterns out to commemorate the closing of the Lunar Festival.
All that official business is handled up in Stormwind these days.  You could stop by the Stormwind Visitor's Center if you want to start a guild.
Your actions shame us all, $c. I hurt inside as I beat you senseless.
$n captured the Horde Flag!
Cower before our might! Flee! There will be no victory for the living!

If you heard that all of the Horde and Alliance collections have been completed, then you heard right, $c. All of the goods for the war that we gathered and prepared are in the process of being sent to Cenarion Hold in Silithus, with less than $2113w days until the last of it arrives there. After that I suppose we'll just have to wait and see who assembles that scepter to ring the gong with, which will open the gates to Ahn'Qiraj and herald the war.
You will not defile these mysteries!
The closest gryphon master is located up in Ironforge near The Great Forge itself.  Ye'll need to head to Ironforge if ye want to travel by gryphon.
Now where did I put that companion document?
Flee while you can mortal!
%s kisses her lover.
When our supplies are high, Warmaster Garrick is stationed in the Field of Strife at a catapult, north of Iceblood Garrison.
Administering fists of fury on $n!

Rumors exist of a single, legendary blade of Quel'Serrar crafted for an unknown entity by the combined might of the five Aspects. Before the abominations of Nefarian and Deathwing were thrust into our world, such meetings of the Aspect were represented by the term 'Prismatic.' I could only assume that the Prismatic Blade of Quel'Serrar was a most glorious creation.

Don't be afraid; we're here to aid you. We're grateful for the defense you've granted us within our former home, and as a measure of thanks, we've come to help you return quickly to the Plaguelands should you need it. My compatriot can explain the process further; you'll find him where the arcane energies are strongest within this city.
Death comes!  Rejoice!
How do I form a guild?
You need to be friendly with the orcs of Orgrimmar before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.
They're out there!  I can hear them at night, laughing.  Oh, they'll pay!  They...will...pay!!

Naralex sleeps again!$b$bLong ago, Naralex journeyed to this cavern with the honorable goal of entering the Emerald Dream and regrowing the Barrens into a lush forest. His focus waned and his thoughts became tainted by serpentine visions.$b$bNow, reptilian beasts seep from his dreams to the land. He must be awoken from the nightmare or he will be forever lost, and a great evil unleashed.$b$bOnly after his corrupted servants, the Fanglords, have been slain can I perform the awakening ritual.
By the Light, I'm hungry today. Did you all see Darcy today? She looked great.
Commander, the time has come to charge the Frostwolf filth! Run them through!
%s and Raider Kerr let their wolves rest a bit and drink...
%s activates!

On behalf of the Royal Apothecary Society, I am pleased to offer you the finest steeds available for the Forsaken.  These beasts have endured trials and tribulations as we all have, and now they too have emerged stronger and more resilient than mere mortal flesh would have had them destined to be!  Please, inspect them for yourself and see.
Let me confer with my colleagues.
%s listens to $n's report...
%s is empty.
[PH] This is a placeholder action until i can cancel channeling my spell.
You wish to learn of the stone? Follow me.
You're selling cologne and perfume?

Their manifest forms weak from eons of battle, imprisoned beneath the world - the world that they themselves created - the corruption of the Titan Shapers would permeate through the surface and befoul the Old Gods.$B$BIt was then and there that the brothers did turn. For five millennia a battle was fought at the core of this world.
Stormwind's resident engineer trainer is an ingenious gnome by the name of Lilliam Sparkspindle. He can be found in the back of the Dwarven District.
Excellent work, $n. Let's find the exit. I think I know the way. Follow me!
Let's see if I can hit that bullseye this time.
You work with machines for so long, sometimes you forget about real hearts.
%s is lured out by the sweet scent of the purified food.
I am the head of the family.  Me.  ME!!!
You are unfit to train with me, stranger. Spend some time with my assistant Jhag over there.
Ah yes, another who will stoke the fires and forge the weapons of war. Of course I will teach you how.
